notes.title: January 13 Version Update Announcement (Updated)
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we have updated a new version today, January 13, fixing some problems and adding some new features according to your suggestions.

V1.1 update logs

【 New 】

1. Add leaderboard function
2. Added photo collection function
3. Added the voice of the male lead
In order to thank the players for their strong support for the game, we selected some of the high-quality second creators or game commentary bloggers to make a special thank you list, and presented it in the game, come and help it, looking forward to seeing your ID in it.

You are welcome to pay attention to our official channels and submit your ideas and suggestions, we will continue to strive to provide you with the best game experience, and continue to improve and update the game content. Thanks again for your support, and have fun playing the game.
